name: Instance Bootstrap and Dependency Assembly
description: Define how the application discovers, validates, and assembles all runtime dependencies before entering the ready state.
acceptanceCriteria: Bootstrap sequence is defined as an ordered DAG of dependency checks
Each dependency has a health probe with clear pass/fail output
Bootstrap halts on critical dependency failure with actionable error message
Bootstrap logs every check with timing and result for diagnostics
Application does not enter ready state until all dependencies are validated
required_evidence: Health probe pass/fail test for each dependency
Bootstrap halt on critical failure test
Diagnostic log output test with timing
acceptance_gates: Bootstrap completes only after all dependencies validated
Each dependency check produces clear pass/fail
Critical failure halts with actionable error
rollback_strategy: Bootstrap has no side effects to roll back — failure leaves no state
recovery_strategy: Retry bootstrap from clean state after resolving failure cause
escalation_policy: After max bootstrap attempts, escalate to user with failure diagnostics and resolution hints
